issues.claim: YOLOv11 vs YOLOv8 visitor-counting figures (84.02% vs 77.15%, MAE 7.22 vs 10.67) cited to https://ejournal.nusamandiri.ac.id/index.php/jitk/article/download/7759/1756/33981
issues.problem: The cited URL returns HTTP 403 on direct fetch, so the page could not be re-opened. The figures themselves check out (nine videos, five tourist sites, the two accuracies and the two MAE values) against indexed copies of the same paper, but the brief's own citation is not openable.
issues.fix: Swap the download URL for an openable copy (DOI or indexed landing page) so the number has a link a reader can actually open; keep strength 'Low'.

issues.claim: Embedded tailgating/piggybacking system at 90.8% accuracy, 320x240, 7 fps, cited to a ResearchGate publication page
issues.problem: ResearchGate returns HTTP 403 to automated fetch, so the citation could not be re-opened. The 90.8% / 320x240 / 7 fps details are corroborated by the IEEE Xplore record for the same 2012 conference paper, so the number is not misstated, only the link is unopenable.
issues.fix: Cite the IEEE Xplore record (document 6504324) instead of the ResearchGate page.

issues.claim: YOLO counting study year is given as '2025 data in a 2026 issue'
issues.problem: Neither field could be confirmed: the article file is 403-blocked and secondary copies show the journal/volume but not a clean 2025-data / 2026-issue statement.
issues.fix: Drop the year qualifier or restate it as 'publication year unverified', keeping the strength at Low either way.

issues.claim: PayRange is described as 'the de facto owner of laundromat machine telemetry and therefore of the machine-status data an AI layer would want'
issues.problem: Presented as fact but no source is cited for a market-share/positioning claim; the pricing page only supports price and product scope.
issues.fix: Label it an inference from the vendor's market presence, or soften to 'a large cashless-payment vendor in laundromats whose machine data an AI layer would want'.

issues.problem: Sits slightly below the cited 2024 CLA survey, which puts median total non-owner employees at 4 (mean 6.2) and median machines at 62. Not a misquoted statistic (the profile is a planning band, not attributed to the survey), but a reader could read it as survey-derived.
issues.fix: Change to '0-4 staff, 20-80 machines' or state explicitly that the staffing band is a targeting judgment rather than a survey figure.

issues.claim: Middlesex County buyers are 'dense along the Route 1/18/130 corridors within a short drive of Milltown'
issues.problem: Geographic colour with no source; the cited county page gives the establishment count only, not corridor concentration.
issues.fix: Mark as inference/planning judgement, or drop the corridor detail.

issues.claim: PayRange weekly fee band $0.99-$1.50 per machine per week
issues.problem: The rendered page text yielded only the '+$35.00 one-time activation fee per NEW device' line; the per-week figures sit in a comparison chart that did not extract. The band is corroborated ($0.99 Essentials, $1.25 Plus, $1.50 Advanced) only from the page as surfaced by search, not from body text I could read.
issues.fix: Keep the figure but note 'read from the plan comparison chart on the pricing page' so the sourcing is explicit.
